bodyHtml:
What This Is

AI systems that detect and block payment fraud in milliseconds using behavioural, transactional and contextual signals; critical as instant payments remove correction windows.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

78% of financial institutions expect fraud to increase significantly from digital currency and agent-based systems. Real-time AI fraud detection critical as instant payments remove error-correction windows. Accenture/Creatio 2026.

Status

Confidence Score +0.72

  • Agentic Banking Platform
